sources.title: Hate Crimes and LGBTI Protection: Which Law Changed What
sources.claim_summary: Criminal-law firm analysis (June 2026) disentangling Spain's 2023 reform: what Organic Law 4/2023 does and does not do; the Penal Code Article 22.4 aggravating circumstance for bias motivated by gender identity or expression; and the Article 510 hate-offences provision extended to trans and LGBTI people - with the practical sentencing consequence of each.
